dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, this potion is turning out to be trickier than Paimon thought it would be...

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: Well, making a potion that has the power to topple the wine industry is sure to be complicated — more complicated than mixing drinks, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: You know what? I'm gonna take a look around the area to collect some more materials.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ah, if you're looking for high-quality materials, I know just where to go!

dialogues.speaker: Diona
dialogues.text: #Perfect! Lead the way... {NICKNAME}, Paimon, we'll see you later!
